facts.text: W Punta Cana is an adults-only all-inclusive resort.
facts.excerpt: At our all-inclusive hotel in Punta Cana for adults

facts.text: The Wet Deck infinity pool stretches along the shore.
facts.excerpt: unwind at the stunning 80-meter Wet Deck infinity pool that stretches along the shore

facts.text: All guestrooms and suites have ocean or resort views and private balconies, with select swim-up or plunge pool options.
facts.excerpt: features striking ocean or resort views, private balconies, and select swim-up or plunge pool options

facts.text: Every room has a rainfall shower and a deep soaking bathtub.
facts.excerpt: includes a rainfall shower and deep soaking bathtub

facts.text: Some suites have a private pool that is a true swimming space beyond a typical plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: a suite with your own private pool that go beyond the typical plunge and offers a true swimming space

facts.text: The Larimar Penthouse is a three-bedroom oceanfront suite with a private pool, a separate kitchen and a Personal Insider butler service.
facts.excerpt: three bedrooms, private pool, multiple living spaces, separate kitchen and Personal Insider (butler service)

facts.text: Every room has a king-size bed, even doubles.
facts.excerpt: King-Size Beds in Every Room, Even Doubles

facts.text: AWAY Spa sits over the ocean with passive and active wet zones, a relaxation area, a beauty salon and a gym studio.
facts.excerpt: A circadian rhythm of daily rebirth over the ocean at our Punta Cana hotel with a spa. A passage of time, where our experience with water is always present. Passive wet zone, Active wet zone, Relaxation area

facts.text: Scena reimagines traditional Dominican ingredients in an open-kitchen setting.
facts.excerpt: Chef-driven concept that re-imagines traditional Dominican ingredients in an open-kitchen, experiential setting.

facts.text: 33 1/3 Speakeasy is hidden behind a casual shop, with vinyl music and vintage arcade games.
facts.excerpt: Unscripted mixology allies with vintage arcade games. Step beyond the ordinary in an intimate setting hidden behind a casual shop.

facts.text: The Chill Pool has a swim-up bar surrounded by lush landscaping.
facts.excerpt: An idyllic swim-up bar at our Chill Pool. Surrounded by lush landscaping

facts.text: A daily calendar includes music experiences, local culture workshops, wellness programs and adventure activities.
facts.excerpt: Daily calendar of unexpected music experiences, after-dark events in our speakeasy bar, local culture workshops, wellness programs, unique adventure activities

facts.text: The resort was designed by architect Pino Violante in a horseshoe shape, with native materials such as Caballero white marble.
facts.excerpt: Native materials, like Caballero white marble from the north coast, run throughout the property, giving it a sandy, neutral appearance.

facts.text: The resort is in Uvero Alto, a more secluded stretch of Punta Cana known for laid-back beaches.
facts.excerpt: The Uvero Alto region is a more secluded stretch of Punta Cana, famous for its laid-back beaches.

facts.text: The resort is about a one-hour drive from Punta Cana International Airport.
facts.excerpt: The one-hour drive from Punta Cana International Airport was a procession of walled-in resorts

facts.text: Excursions such as mountain buggy rides, cenote dives and private sails can be booked through the resort's Adventure Center.
facts.excerpt: which you can book through the resort’s Adventure Center. These include everything from mountain buggy rides and cenote dives to private sails and visits to national parks

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

facts.text: Selected alcoholic beverages including wines, champagne, beers and cocktails are included.
facts.excerpt: Selected range of alcoholic beverages included such as wines, champagne, beers, and cocktails

facts.text: The spa has a Himalayan salt sauna, a steam room and hot and cold pools.
facts.excerpt: several pools (including hot pools and cold plunges), a beauty salon, a Himalayan salt sauna, a steam room

facts.text: Spa treatments are not part of the all-inclusive package; hydrotherapy is included with treatments.
facts.excerpt: Hydrotherapy experiences are included with all treatments, though these are not part of the all-inclusive package.
